versions.content: If SoAdSocketTcpAutoConnectTimeout has elapsed for that socket connection and the socket connection has not yet reached SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE , then 1. the runtime error SOAD_E_TCP_AUTOCONNECT_FAILED shall be raised. 2. the socket connection shall close related TcpIp socket. 3. the socket connection shall be put into SOAD_SOCON_OFFLINE . 4. the socket connection shall stay in SOAD_SOCON_OFFLINE .
